'''November 2000 San Jose tournament (11 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in San Jose, California on 11 November 2000. [[Dan Mochizuki]] won it. It is known from Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1450">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-12-san-jose-ca-11-11-00d1450/ san-jose-ca-11-11-00], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 12 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-12-san-jose-ca-11-11-00d1450/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 November 2000
* '''Site:''' San Jose, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Dan Mochizuki]]
